title: Design Studio Selections Video Appointment Terms: Channel Rate for Consultation Fees
content:
A design consultation fee on a Design Studio Selections file is charged at a channel rate set by how the billed appointment was held:

- an appointment held by video that ran longer than the package's appointment hours is billed at 80 percent;
- an appointment held by video within the package's appointment hours is billed at 60 percent;
- an appointment held in the studio is billed at 100 percent.

The channel and the designer hours used are read from the billed appointment's entry on the design ledger. "Within the package's appointment hours" means hours used not exceeding the package's appointment hours; equal to them is within.

**Package appointment hours**

| Package | Appointment hours | Video appointment of exactly these hours | Video appointment of more than these hours |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 2.0 | 60 percent | 80 percent |
| Studio Classic | 3.0 | 60 percent | 80 percent |
| Studio Select | 3.0 | 60 percent | 80 percent |
| Studio Designer | 4.0 | 60 percent | 80 percent |
| Studio Signature | 4.0 | 60 percent | 80 percent |
| Studio Atelier | 6.0 | 60 percent | 80 percent |

**Hypothetical cases** (Studio Designer, 4.0 appointment hours)

| Channel | Hours used | Channel rate |
|---|---|---|
| Video | 3.5 | 60 percent |
| Video | 4.0 | 60 percent |
| Video | 4.5 | 80 percent |
| Studio | 5.0 | 100 percent |
